channel.title: Records Research Group
channel.description: Public-records accessibility research — Oregon administrative and financial records. Findings, derived datasets, and the request/response record itself, free at the point of access (CC0).

item.title: Lane County study update: two fee waivers denied; $1,284.59 quoted across four estimates
item.description: Lane County denied fee waivers on requests #26-971 and #26-974, citing the requester's "plan and ability to distribute the information." Invoices: $186.48 (payroll), $728.89 (voter-roll statistics). City of Eugene issued a $277.20 estimate (PRR-2026-896). Waiver record: 0 granted, 2 denied, 2 pending.

item.title: Lane County records accessibility study — research note posted
item.description: A systematic set of Oregon Public Records Law requests to Lane County and Oregon state agencies, measuring how much routine administrative and financial information is visible to the public — and what it costs to get what isn't.
